latest_release.name: v0.29.0
latest_release.body:
## Overview

ggml v0.29.0 adds an OCP FP8 E4M3 tensor type, a new `ggml_flash_attn_ext_rows` op where each query slice attends to its own list of K/V rows, a batched tensor copy API, and initial support for multi-node tensor parallelism through a new multi-process communicator interface. Core improvements include bounding tensor views by the bytes their strides reach, zero-copy GGUF export of host-buffer tensors, and `vm_allocate`-based allocations on Apple platforms. Performance work spans all major backends: new SVE kernels in the CPU backend, DPAS flash attention for quantized KV in SYCL, fused MoE MMQ in CUDA, faster MXFP4 mat-vec in Metal, split-K tuning in Vulkan, and a large expansion of quantized GEMM/GEMV coverage in OpenCL. The Hexagon backend gains support for several new ops, including the lightning indexer, top-k mask, conv2d and upscale.

### API changes

- Add `GGML_TYPE_F8_E4M3` (OCP FP8 E4M3) with float conversion helpers and `GGML_FTYPE_MOSTLY_F8_E4M3` ([#27512](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27512))
- Add `ggml_flash_attn_ext_rows()`: FA variant where each q slice attends to its own K/V row list via index tensor ([#29510](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29510))
- Add batched `ggml_backend_tensor_copy_n()`, `ggml_backend_tensor_set_n()` and `ggml_backend_tensor_get_n()` APIs ([#30881](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30881))
- Add a multi-process communicator interface (`ggml_backend_comm_init_rank_t`) for collectives across separate ranks ([#28967](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28967))

### Core changes

- Bound tensor views by the bytes their strides reach and validate strided views against the source extent ([#31584](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31584))
- GGUF writer: write host-buffer tensor data directly to the output stream without an intermediate copy ([#31144](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31144))
- Use `vm_allocate` instead of `posix_memalign` for large allocations on all Apple platforms ([#31437](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31437))
- Meta backend: keep tensor splits across permuted views and avoid mirrored splits for ARANGE ([#30499](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30499) [#30878](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30878))
- Speed up IQ4 quantization with pre-computed halfway points ([#31201](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31201))

### Backend changes

#### CPU

- Add SVE 256-bit kernels: MXFP4 GEMV ([#28141](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28141)), Q6_K GEMM ([#27472](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27472)) and q8_0 4x8 GEMV ([#30585](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30585))
- Gate RVV code on the target vector extension so it is not built for rv64gc without V ([#31607](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31607))
- Implement `ggml_flash_attn_ext_rows` ([#29510](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29510))

#### CUDA

- Add NCCL support for multi-node tensor parallelism via the multi-process communicator, used by the RPC server ([#28967](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28967))
- Gather batched tensor reads into mapped host memory for the batched copy APIs ([#31391](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31391))
- Fuse MoE (`MUL_MAT_ID`) gate/up projections with GLU in MMQ ([#31188](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31188))
- Implement `ggml_flash_attn_ext_rows` ([#29510](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29510))
- HIP: enable sparse attention on CDNA ([#31259](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31259)) and add RDNA4_M family for gfx1170/gfx1171 ([#31373](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31373))
- Fix Q8_1 correction sum in MMQ ([#31247](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31247)) and premature eviction of CUDA graphs ([#30662](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30662))

#### SYCL

- Add DPAS flash attention kernel for q4_0/q8_0 KV cache

# ggml
Tensor library for machine learning [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ggml-org/ggml?filter=v*)](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases) [![CI](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/actions/workflows/build-cpu.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/actions/workflows/build-cpu.yml)
## Quick start Build from source: ```bash git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml cd ggml mkdir build && cd build cmake .. cmake --build . --config Release -j 8 ``` For a minimal, fully commented example (matrix multiplication), see [examples/simple](examples/simple). ## Description The main goal of `ggml` is to be a simple, portable, and efficient tensor library for machine learning with minimal setup. - Plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies - Cross-platform - x86, ARM, RISC-V, LoongArch, PowerPC, s390x, and WebAssembly - SIMD-optimized kernels for x86, ARM, and RISC-V - Broad backend support - CPU, GPU, NPU, and browser - 2- to 8-bit integer quantization, plus MXFP4 and NVFP4 microscaling formats - Zero memory allocations during runtime ## Documentation - [The GGUF file format](docs/gguf.md) - [Introduction to ggml](https://huggingface.co/blog/introduction-to-ggml) - [GGML tips & tricks](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/wiki/GGML-Tips-&-Tricks) ## Contributing - For changes to the core `ggml` library (including to the CMake build system), please open a PR in [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) - doing so will make your PR more visible, better tested, and more likely to be reviewed
